description: On the tabletop in front of you, there’s a small stack of playing cards held together with a yellow rubber band, with a blue rubber band lying nearby. The left hand steadies the card stack as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches in from the right to pick up the blue rubber band as a right-hand object, stretches it open, and slides it over the stack so it wraps across the top, then eases tension and lets it rest around the cards.
